items.title: ⚡Flash Heard: AI Splurge Worries Investors—But Drives Chip Stock Rebound
items.summary: The picks and shovels of the AI boom are still hard at work.  Alphabet last week and Meta Platforms yesterday raised their capital-spending plans for this year and suggested more was to come in 2027.  Microsoft also painted a picture of lavish AI spending ahead last night, although an accounting change resulted in a reduction to its nominal total for the year.
